ideas.pitch: An AI-powered multi-modal green logistics routing platform designed for Indian urban delivery fleets.
ideas.problem_statement: Open Innovation theme focusing on sustainability and real-world technology solutions in India.
ideas.title: EcoRoute India
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the exact pattern of GreenNovation Hackathon winner by combining spatial AI with measurable environmental impact, which appeals strongly to open innovation judges looking for practical decarbonization tools.

ideas.pitch: A multi-lingual student health and first-aid triage mobile web app designed for university campuses across India.
ideas.problem_statement: Open Innovation theme focusing on local community, wellness, and practical institutional problem-solving.
ideas.title: CampusCare Triage
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the Place Hackathon 2nd place winner by offering multi-language support and immediate, practical utility that judges can test live on their phones.

ideas.pitch: A real-time civic issue logging and automated municipal dispatch dashboard using spatial data.
ideas.problem_statement: Open Innovation theme focusing on urban infrastructure and community governance.
ideas.title: CivicPulse India
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the winning formula of Chatswood AI Real-World Impact Hackathon by pairing a clean user reporting interface with a live administrative dashboard that demonstrates clear civic value.

ideas.pitch: An automated satellite and drone imagery monitoring tool for agricultural land-use compliance in rural India.
ideas.problem_statement: Open Innovation theme addressing industrial and agricultural resource monitoring.
ideas.title: AgriVision Compliance
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly applies the architectural blueprint of the Xcelerate Hackathon runner-up by transforming complex geospatial data into an actionable compliance interface.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered mentorship and micro-internship matching platform tailored for multidisciplinary university students in India.
ideas.problem_statement: Open Innovation theme focused on education, student employment, and cross-branch collaboration.
ideas.title: SkillBridge AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a massive pain point for the exact demographic participating in the hackathon (college students across India), scoring high on relatable real-world impact and live-demo feasibility.
